$comment: Schema history for Alcatrazer's three declared schemas. Single source of truth, consumed by src/alcatrazer/schema.py at runtime and (planned) by CI checks that diff this file between tags to enforce CHANGELOG mention. Editing rule: docs/coding_conventions.md 'Schema changes must land in schemas.json + CHANGELOG before release'.

state.role: dynamic — Alcatrazer's runtime state, written by daemon + CLI

history.summary: Initial state.json — CLI/daemon shutdown-intent cooperation. File is lazily created on first 'alcatrazer stop'/'clear'; absent after a plain 'init' or 'start'.
Promotion rework: unified pin + replay + paused fields directly in state.json, retiring the side files promoted-tips.json and paused-branches.json.

alcatrazer_config.role: static — Alcatrazer's per-developer tool configuration; not under user-repo version control (gitignored)

history.summary: Initial .alcatrazer/config.toml — promotion identity + sync-daemon knobs. File carries no schema_version field at this version; the version label is applied externally for tracking history.

coding_env.role: user-facing — declares the OS packages, language runtimes, and post-start commands the agent's workspace will be built with; lives in the user's repo, under version control

history.summary: Initial coding-environment.toml — declares OS packages, language runtimes + managers, and post-start commands.
